column1: # Game profile of Silver Pines 1.0.0 (Unity 6000.3.15f1 IL2CPP with the Universal Render Pipeline, FMOD, SDK 21.4.7, NVN).
# Format: see dm/games/README.md; bring-up and measurements in README.md beside this file.
# Virtual address memory: the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource and main never sets a heap, so a 5 GB block with a 4.375 GB alias region, where the game maps
# its memory itself. The surveyed values held: about 2.1 GB resident and 1 GB of Metal allocations in the motel street (README.md)
# the NPDM declares 16 MB of system resource
# The game calls nvnDeviceSetDepthMode(near=0), so its vertex shaders use the main0_z entries; the pipeline bases made before it runs (the Mac app's archive,
# the Mac prebuild) are made for that mode. Without it the Mac app's 1 GB archive was made for near = -w and the first start rebuilt all 27,834 pairs (README.md)
